A Math-First Fix for Procedural Skin Tones Reclaims Color Craft
item.description: By mapping human skin gamut through custom color space transformations rather than naive RGB interpolation, this lightweight algorithm eliminates the muddy artifacts long tolerated in procedural generation. The tradeoff lies in implementation overhead: rendering pipelines must absorb a non-standard color transform step, proving that escaping lazy approximations still requires upfront geometric discipline.
